{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes starting at day 4, with a lag of 2-3 days after sentiment changes",
    "Sentiment turning negative causes model to overshoot highs by 1-2 euros on days 4-7",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes prices to be too high by 0.5-1.0 euros when sentiment is strongly positive",
    "Model fails to capture the deceleration in price recovery after sentiment turns negative, overpredicting by 0.3-0.6 euros",
    "Sentiment strength correlation: very strong (1.0) sentiment predicts outcomes 0.2-0.4 euros too low",
    "Moderate sentiment (0.33-0.67) causes model to over-smooth, lagging behind true price volatility by 1-2 days",
    "When prices are in a clear downtrend, model maintains inflated forecasts 0.4-0.8 euros above reality due to insufficient fear sentiment"
] }
